openQuestions.question: Does boarding a tram or sky rail to move around the city (fast travel) cost anything: cash, Trail, Alert, a cooldown, or a witness exposure? Is it allowed during a mission?
openQuestions.why: Datum's hold lists boarding as fast travel but the GDD sets no price or rule; none is assumed in these timetables.

openQuestions.question: Is boarding fast travel meant to be available to the player at all, and should it count as a traceable act or a witnessed one?
openQuestions.why: It affects pillar 2 (open or close a window the player can see coming); only Sky can decide that.

openQuestions.question: Headways (T1 150 s, T2 180 s, S1 120 s) and dwells (trams 15 s, sky rail 12 s) are not in the GDD. Does Motive want other values?
openQuestions.why: They are starting values [S] to tune by playtest.

notes: Speeds are my assumptions: trams 8 m/s (about 29 km/h) cruise, sky rail 12 m/s (about 43 km/h). Run sec = chainage gap / speed, rounded up to the next whole second. No acceleration allowance.

Journey sec = in-vehicle run times + dwell at each intermediate stop on the way. It excludes the origin dwell, the wait for a vehicle (up to one headway) and the interchange walk. The plan does not give interchange distances beyond the ≤150 m standard, so I did not price the walk.

Both directions run on every line (double track), with the same run times each way. The plan gives no turnback or terminus timing. T1 trunk and T2 run through off-sheet to depots, and S1 runs on past Skyport (loop) and west past Sphere Gardens. Plan question open: T1 terminates on the circus loop, as drawn.
Interchanges used: T1/records with T2/market, T1/circus with S1/circus, T2/harbour with S1/harbour. Journeys name the interchange stop on the line the rider leaves.

Open conflict in the sources: the notes ask to retire the old Sphere loop and harbour line, but the candidate S1 still has a Skyport balloon loop. I timed no loop and did not resolve this. Datum or Sky should decide.
